Without camera access only manual entry is possible.

The check only shows whether the MRZ is internally consistent and plausible. It is not proof of authenticity: a forgery with correctly calculated check digits is not detected here. All data stays on the device and is not stored.
Hold the machine-readable zone (2 or 3 lines with <<<) inside the frame – back of the ID card or passport data page.
Choose the document type and type it in – fixed parts and < are added automatically.
Line 2: birth date+CD, expiry+CD, version (2108) if any, composite CD

Card access number (CAN, optional) – 6 digits, usually on the front of ID cards. Without a CAN, access uses the scanned MRZ (usual for passports).
Please enter the 6-digit CAN – or first scan the MRZ with correct check digits.
Now hold the ID card flat against the back of the phone and do not move it …
Done. For a new check, hold the document against the phone again.
NFC is switched off – please switch it on in the settings.

Checked are access, hash and signature of the chip data and the issuing state\'s root certificate – if a matching list has been imported. Not checked are the chip\'s clone protection and whether the document is reported blocked or stolen. Facial image and fingerprints are not read. On the German ID card the chip data is reserved for authorities. Document data is not stored.
Access with CAN. Now hold the document flat against the back of the phone and do not move it …
Access via the scanned MRZ. Hold the document (for passports the data page or the cover containing the chip) flat against the back of the phone and do not move it …
No list imported – access, hash and signature are checked, but not the origin of the signature.
Remove all imported certificate lists from the app?

Download the list yourself and select it here – the app downloads nothing from the internet. Suitable: GermanMasterList.zip from the BSI (directly, no need to unzip), ICAO PKD files (.ldif) or single certificates (.cer, .der, .pem). Only use files from a trustworthy source.
